items.item_text: Current registration with the Board of Behavioral Sciences as one of the following: Marriage and Family Therapist Intern, Associate Clinical Social Worker, Psychological Assistant, Associate Professional Clinical Counselor, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist/Counselor: CA, National Certified Counselor, or Social Worker: CA
Graduation from an accredited college or university with a Masters degree in an appropriate behavioral science discipline

Utilizes work time efficiently through proper time management, shows flexibility in work schedule so that it meets clinic, client and team's needs, contributes to the efficiency of the office by completing tasks in a timely manner so that other team members can complete their tasks.
Demonstrates an ability to assess a situation, consider alternatives, select and implement an appropriate and tactful course of action.
Provides expected amount of billable services as established by specific program (County Contracted Programs) OR provides expected number of direct face-to-face client sessions per week

Ability to obtain intake history, organize and concisely restate presenting issues, discuss informed consent, legal limits of confidentiality, cancellation and no-show policy, scope of practice, commitment to therapy, agreement on time frame.
